tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the header bar. The ground a property card sits on.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background. Every screen starts here.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Sunken areas: skeleton blocks, image placeholders, inactive tabs.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Anything floating above the page: dropdowns, bottom sheets, toasts.

tokens.name: ink-900
tokens.usage: Primary text: headings, prices, property titles.

tokens.name: ink-700
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, body copy, card attributes.

tokens.name: ink-500
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: timestamps, helper text, captions. Never below 13px.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on a saturated fill where no dedicated on-* token exists.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Card edges, dividers, input borders at rest. The default separator in lists.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders on hover, selected chips, table rules that must read.

tokens.name: brand-600
tokens.usage: The buyer's primary action: Search, Enquire, Save. One per surface.

tokens.name: brand-700
tokens.usage: Pressed and hover state of brand-600.

tokens.name: brand-100
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds: selected filter chips, the active tab underline's field.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand-600. Flips to dark ink in dark theme — never hardcode white.

tokens.name: supply-600
tokens.usage: The seller's action: Post Property, Publish, Renew. Must never look like brand-600.

tokens.name: supply-100
tokens.usage: Tinted seller surfaces: the owner CTA band, draft banners.

tokens.name: on-supply
tokens.usage: Text and icons on supply-600.

tokens.name: trust-600
tokens.usage: Verified badges, Active listing status, success confirmations.

tokens.name: trust-100
tokens.usage: Field behind a verified badge or an Active status pill.

tokens.name: warn-600
tokens.usage: Under Screening, Expiring soon, incomplete listing warnings.

tokens.name: warn-100
tokens.usage: Field behind a warning pill or banner.

tokens.name: danger-600
tokens.usage: Rejected listings, destructive actions, validation errors, Report.

tokens.name: danger-100
tokens.usage: Field behind an error message or a Rejected pill.

tokens.name: neutral-600
tokens.usage: Expired, Deleted and other inactive states. Deliberately colourless.

tokens.name: neutral-100
tokens.usage: Field behind an inactive status pill.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The 2px focus outline. Never remove a focus ring without replacing it.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind modals, bottom sheets and the gallery lightbox.

tokens.name: media-ground
tokens.usage: Behind a property photo before it loads. Holds the 4:3 box so nothing shifts.

styles.name: display-1
styles.usage: Homepage headline only. One per page.
styles.sample: Find your next home in Kolkata

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Page H1: search results count, property title.
styles.sample: 2 BHK flats for sale in New Town

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Card group headings, sheet titles, wizard step titles.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Property description. The only place long prose appears.
styles.sample: South-facing flat on the 7th floor with an open balcony.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI text. Never go below this for content.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Card attributes, helper text, list meta.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, chips, buttons, tab labels.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows above a section. Use sparingly.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Legal text, disclaimers, photo counters. The smallest permitted size.
styles.sample: Verified photos only — we do not verify ownership

styles.name: price-lg
styles.usage: Price on the property detail page. Always tabular-nums.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Price on a property card. The largest thing on the card.

spacing.note: A 4px base. Nothing between these steps — an arbitrary value is a bug, not a decision.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge inner padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, between a label and its field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inner padding of a compact card, list row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default card padding and the page side gutter. Never less on mobile.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between cards, between form groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Space above and below a major section on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page top and bottom margins on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badges, small inline tags.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, select fields, filter chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and cards. The default.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Property card outer edge, image corners.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and modals — top corners only on a sheet.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills, avatars, the photo counter.

shadow.note: Four levels, used by role. In long result lists prefer border-subtle over any shadow — shadows cost paint performance on scroll.

tokens.name: shadow-0
tokens.usage: Cards inside a scrolling result list. The default.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: A card lifted on hover, on pointer devices only.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Dropdowns, typeahead suggestion panels, popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, the sticky contact bar, modals.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls. Pair with a not-allowed cursor, never with a colour change alone.

tokens.name: opacity-scrim
tokens.usage: Image overlays behind a photo counter or badge.

tokens.name: z-header
tokens.usage: Sticky app header.

tokens.name: z-bottomnav
tokens.usage: Mobile bottom navigation.

tokens.name: z-contactbar
tokens.usage: Sticky contact bar on the property page — above bottom nav, which it replaces.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind sheets and modals.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, modals, the filter sheet.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts. Always the topmost layer.
